title: Loaded Pulled Pork Hash Browns
description: Crispy oven hash browns topped with pulled pork, corn, and habanero jalapeno jack. Start the hash browns when the pork is on natural release.

ingredients.item: toppings: sour cream, BBQ sauce, Mt. Olive candied jalapenos, ranch

steps: Make the hash browns (R2) right on the sheet pan.
Microwave the corn with a pat of butter and a pinch of salt, 2 to 3 min, stir.
Top the crispy hash browns with pulled pork, corn, then cheese.
Back in the oven (Air Fry 425°F) 3 to 5 min, until the cheese melts.
Top with sour cream, a drizzle of BBQ sauce, and candied jalapenos.
source: Joe's Meal Pack, Oct 20 to Nov 4, 2026 (built by Thrifty, now kept by Meal Plan), R4
